_help: LIVE MISSION CONTROL: edit this file before each launch. Full guide: docs/live-streams.md
1. youtube streams: paste the YouTube URL, the 11-character video ID, or YouTube's whole <iframe> embed code into 'video'.
2. x stream: paste the x.com/i/broadcasts/... link (or X's <blockquote> embed code) into 'broadcastUrl'. Without a broadcast, 'postUrl' embeds a post instead.
3. Optional: set launch.ll2LaunchId to pin a launch; otherwise the page follows the next launch from launch.nextFromProvider.
Empty values are fine: a panel without a link shows 'Unavailable' with a button to the broadcaster's channel.
The first mission is shown by default; add more missions to get a mission selector.
